items.title: 한울 지붕 공놀이
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one gameplay concept screenshot for a Korean fantasy 2D pixel-art videogame article.
Primary request: Create a SINGLE polished, readable wide 16:9 in-game screenshot, 1536x864 target composition, for "Hanul Rooftop Volley", a real-time 2-versus-2 arcade volleyball game in Eoul, a bright folklore world where humans and Korean dokkaebi are friendly neighbors.
Scene: A broad SAFE roof-terrace sports court among Korean hanok tiled roofs at a late-afternoon lantern festival. The flat padded play surface is large, visible, and bordered with a sturdy low safety fence. A volleyball NET stretches across the exact middle, vertically dividing left and right teams in SIDE VIEW. Soft sunset gold, teal glazed roof tiles, hanging fabric pennants, subtle festival city backdrop. Playfield occupies most of screen.
Subjects and gameplay: EXACTLY FOUR clearly separate cute sprite players in the court, precisely TWO on each side of the net. Each side has one human in short practical hanbok sports clothes and one friendly small dokkaebi; blue scarves for left team, coral scarves for right team. The human on the left is the selected player, with a clear cyan outline, ready beneath ONE glowing cloth ball suspended above the left half of the court. A cyan predicted landing ring is drawn on the play surface under the ball. Their dokkaebi teammate stands farther toward the back left in a ready position. The two opponents on the right are spread out and watching the ball. All four feet must visibly contact the same safe play surface. One ball only. No extra spectators close to court that could read as players.
UI: Compact pixel UI, top center score EXACTLY "3 : 2". Upper left a tiny ball icon and text EXACTLY "1 / 3" for current team touches. A slim bottom control strip has three small icon buttons clearly labeled "PASS", "LOB", "SPIKE", with a hand/arc/diagonal-arrow icon. Selected-player focus and landing-ring positioning must be visually easy to read. No title, no paragraphs, no speech.
Style: authentic crisp hand-placed 2D pixel-art game screenshot, square pixel edges, limited coherent colors, readable 24-to-40-pixel-scale characters and tiled scenery, pixel UI, no blur, no painterly gradients, no photorealism, no 3D or isometric rendering. Opaque rectangular image edge to edge.
Constraints: Sport, positioning, and limited touches are the central activity. No cards, no weapons, no combat, no turn grid, no monsters attacking, no poster layout, no large typography. Show a playable spatial scene, not promotional art.
factual_qa: 원본 육안 확인: 사람2명·도깨비2명, 그물 양편2명씩으로 2v2 성립
한 장면의 공1개, 왼쪽 선수 선택 윤곽, 왼쪽 낙하지점 표시
점수3:2 및 팀 접촉1/3, PASS/LOB/SPIKE 아이콘 표시
도성 한울의 축제·장터 분위기 차용; 지붕 배구장 및 스포츠 규칙은 이번 기획의 창작
컨셉 플레이 화면이며 구현된 게임 캡처가 아님
items.processing: RGB conversion, nearest-neighbor resize to 1536x864, WebP quality92 method6. No visual retouch or compositing.
items.final_visual_review: 1536x864 WebP를 view_image로 다시 열어 원본 대비 구성·인물 수·UI·모습 유지 확인 완료.

items.title: 상서 관측소의 하루
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one gameplay concept screenshot for a Korean fantasy 2D pixel-art videogame article.
Primary request: Create a SINGLE polished, readable wide 16:9 in-game screenshot, 1536x864 target composition, for "A Day at the Auspicious Observatory", a gentle stealth wildlife-photography observation game set in Eoul, a bright Korean folklore world.
Scene: A sunny pine grove and Korean hanok garden with white plaster walls, a tiled garden pavilion, a tiny natural pond, stepping stones and LOW hedges. TOP-DOWN 2D tile-game camera with clearly readable ground paths and sprite figures. Bright and peaceful, muted leaf greens with warm cream and restrained pale teal HUD.
Subjects and visible gameplay: ONE human observer in practical hanbok crouches behind a low hedge near lower center, quietly aiming a small fictional wooden light-box optical recording device toward a WHITE MAGPIE on a pine branch near upper-right of center. Bird must read as an elegant white magpie with a long tail, not a dove, not a chicken. The camera is a handmade wood-and-brass magical in-world invention rather than a modern DSLR. A thin rectangular cyan observation frame surrounds the white magpie and its perch. The bird faces right, with a faint pale-yellow triangular sight cone projecting right across the open ground, so the hiding observer below-left is outside its line of sight. Show a restrained orange dotted FOOTSTEP NOISE RADIUS circle centered on the observer, partially clipped by the hedge, with a tiny footstep icon; this is an informational UI overlay. A fabric WIND-DIRECTION RIBBON near the pond points to the right. Far away along the upper-left path ONE peaceful villager sweeps fallen leaves, a modest secondary moving-noise source, not an enemy or another photographer.
HUD: Minimal and readable. Top left a small sun/time icon and "08:20". Upper right small feather icon and "CALM". At bottom left a small thumbnail preview of the SAME white magpie, with a circular hold-to-observe progress indicator about two-thirds full surrounding a shutter symbol. Bottom center EXACT text "0 / 3" beside three empty film or paper-record slots. Bottom right three simple bird pose checklist icons, each with an empty square: perched bird, wings spread, drinking at water. These are three target photos of the SAME species. Minimal English words plus symbols only. No written quest paragraphs or Korean text.
Style: authentic crisp hand-placed 2D pixel-art gameplay screenshot, square pixel edges, coherent limited palette, tile-based ground and 24-to-40-pixel-scale sprites, detailed readable pine foliage, no blur, no painterly gradients, no photorealism, no 3D render, no isometric view. Opaque full-bleed rectangular screenshot.
Constraints: Image must visibly explain quiet movement, avoiding a bird's sight, framing a rare animal, waiting for a photo pose. Exactly one physical white magpie in the game world; small HUD preview/icons are allowed. The bird is not captured, chased, trapped or threatened. No predators, no combat, no weapons, no gore, no traps, no capture net, no cards, no turn-grid, no horror. No promotional poster layout or large title. Respectful observation is the central action.
factual_qa: 원본 육안 확인: 흰까치 백작1마리가 가지에 앉아 있고 관측틀 표시
관측자는 낮은 울타리 뒤, 새 시야 범위 밖에 위치; 발소리 원·바람 띠 표시
빗자루로 길을 쓰는 먼 주민1명 외 추가 관측자 없음
상서 관측소·백작·쫓지 않고 지켜보는 법칙은 어울에서 차용; 목제 빛그림 장치는 이번 기획의 창작
컨셉 플레이 화면이며 구현된 게임 캡처가 아님
